content: Tauri 2 uses OS webviews: WKWebView/WebKit on macOS, WebView2/Chromium on Windows, WebKitGTK on Linux, so engine behavior and web API availability vary and old macOS versions are frozen. Multiple webviews in one native window exist behind the unstable Cargo feature via Window::add_child(WebviewBuilder,...) and Webview::reparent, generally undocumented and desktop-only, so Electron WebContentsView parity is not stable. Webview scoping uses WRY WebContext/data_directory or Windows profile_name; Tauri per-profile support is an open issue (#9285) and data_directory is reported unsupported on macOS. WebView2 has an opt-in AreBrowserExtensionsEnabled (default false) for Windows only; no Chrome extension support in WKWebView; WKWebView cannot enable Widevine (FairPlay only, Apple signing/VMP constraints). No cross-platform Wry HTTP request interception API (issue #4899); WebView2 WebResourceRequested is native/Windows-only; WKWebView has no Wry content-blocker API. Custom protocols and capabilities exist; capabilities/permissions do not currently restrict custom protocol access per webview (#13224). Downloads via on_download (wry >=0.53) or Rust save command; official updater plugin requires Tauri signing keys, separate from Apple/Microsoft code signing.
